title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
one_line: SimpleRL-Zoo maths-RL base/RL pairs: a base-budget rule recovers RL pass@k on Math500/AIME/GPQA/IFEval; IFEval aggregate, OOD, budget <= 64; no per-prompt reach (N1 near miss).

title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Optimised two-stage prompts (Qwen3 8B) beat GRPO on IFBench aggregate, 38.61 vs 35.88 (baseline 36.90); prompt vs RL, not a one-line hint or per-prompt reach (N4).

title: SciIF: Benchmarking Scientific Instruction Following Towards Rigorous Scientific Intelligence
one_line: Appendix reads IFEval cases fixed by verifier RL (Qwen3 8B): gains in constraints penalising extra text; pre-RL failures are packaging and elaboration; qualitative, pass@1, unblinded (N5).

title: When the Reward Suite Is Leaky: A Preregistered Causal Contrast of Natural Verifier False Positives in RLVR
one_line: Code GRPO (1-1.5B, MBPP): human audit of every rewarded false positive (47.57 % genuinely wrong); base already emits them; held-out pass@1, no reach (N2 near miss).

title: LLMs Gaming Verifiers: RLVR can Lead to Reward Hacking
one_line: Inductive rule tasks: RLVR models (GPT-5, Olmo3) output label lists that pass extensional verifiers; isomorphic test exposes them; gaming among passes, not reach (N2).

title: Brevity Constraints Reverse Performance Hierarchies in Language Models
one_line: A brevity instruction raises large-model accuracy by 26 pp (31 models, QA and maths): prompt elicitation of latent ability; no RL, no IF reach (N4).

title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
one_line: Traces the wait marker through OLMo-3 and MiMo stages: zero-RL rarely coins it, mid-training installs it; create-vs-elicit of a behaviour, not a large-k reach test (N6).

title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues
one_line: 12-15 open checkpoints over four post-training stages: a citation cue raises fabrication in post-trained, not base, models; prompt-only effect; no reach or large k.

title: When Built-in Thinking Helps and Hurts: Constraint-Level Error Shifts in Instruction Following
one_line: IFEval with Qwen3 thinking on/off: 10-20 % of prompts flip; planning vs precision constraint classes; error shifts by mode, not a start-vs-RL failure reading (N5).

title: When Thinking Fails: The Pitfalls of Reasoning for Instruction-Following in LLMs
one_line: CoT lowers IFEval/ComplexBench accuracy; case studies of where reasoning helps (format) or hurts (neglect, extra content); no RL reach (N5).

title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
one_line: Constraint wording alone moves IF compliance (54.9 % to 33.8 % across forms) and model ranks; prompt-form sensitivity; no RL or reach.

title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
one_line: Per-item recoveries and regressions under automatic prompt optimisation, incl. an instruction-following set; per-item prompt effects, no RL comparison (N4).

title: Verifier Errors in RLVR: Reward Hacking, Limits of Feedback, and Selective Control
one_line: Theory: accepted errors are not identifiable from RLVR observations alone; partial audits allow selective control; bandit and LM experiments; no reach.

title: Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR
one_line: Survey of 58 verifier-error studies: triggerable false positives cause plateaus or collapse; proposes a reporting protocol; no reach-level gaming audit.

title: Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Rubric RL (medical, science): weak-verifier gains fail a three-judge panel; exploitation grows over training; LLM judges, aggregate, not reach.

title: What Drives the Zero-to-One Jump? Diagnosing and Steering Hard-Prompt Learning in RLVR
one_line: Training-time unsolved-to-solved transitions on maths prompts (time to first positive); NAPO lifts AIME pass@256; own runs, not public checkpoints or IF.

title: The Unlocking Spell on Base LLMs: Rethinking Alignment via In-Context Learning
one_line: URIAL (prior): in-context prompting of base LLMs vs aligned chat models; aggregate prompt elicitation of alignment, no RL reach; classic N4 neighbour.

title: Where the Verifier Fails: A Category-Level Audit of Reward Signals in RLVR
one_line: Maths verifiers false negatives by answer category over 307,420 verdicts (metamorphic tests); grading validity, not gaming or reach.

title: BODHI: Do LLMs Branch Out and Discover Heterogeneous Inferences?
one_line: Semantic branching entropy collapses under RLVR (mazes, maths reasoning trees); sample-efficiency reading; no IF, no reach counts.

title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
one_line: Fisher leverage of released Olmo-3, Tulu-3 and OLMo-2 stage updates; weight-space measure, no sampling; checked for N3/N6, not a reach study.

title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
one_line: SDPO/OPSD self-distillation gains do not generalise (Qwen3, OLMo-3-7B); transfer of existing behaviour; no start-vs-RL reach.

title: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training
one_line: Chess testbed (own 5M-1B models): RL surfaces near-absent moves on hard puzzles; no public checkpoints, no IF.

title: What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization
one_line: Reflective prompt optimisation (Qwen3.5-9B) on five sets incl. IFBench; calibration gaps overstate held-out gains; no RL comparison.

title: RLVR-side-effects: isolating the RLVR stage in Olmo-3 (README)
one_line: README (WebFetch summary): Olmo 3 7B base/SFT/DPO/RLVR trait and behaviour probes, 1-3 samples per item, DPO comparison not yet run; no reach (N6 check).

title: LoRA adapters and steering vectors for Olmo-3.1-32B-Think CoT controllability (model card)
one_line: Model card (WebFetch summary): own LoRA/steering checkpoints on Olmo-3.1-32B-Think, 4 samples per prompt on ReasonIF; not Ai2 step branches, no reach (N3 check).
